scripts.build:wasm: rm -rf pkg && wasm-pack build crates/wasm --scope fedibtc --target bundler --out-dir ../../pkg --no-opt && rm -f pkg/.gitignore && pnpm run format:pkg
scripts.check: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run test
scripts.docs: pnpm run docs:api && pnpm run docs:rust && pnpm run docs:rust:copy
scripts.docs:rust:copy: rm -rf dist/docs/api/rust && mkdir -p dist/docs/api/rust && cp -R target/doc/. dist/docs/api/rust/
scripts.test:keygen:ts: pnpm run typecheck && RUN_RSA_KEYGEN_TESTS=1 vitest run test/keygen.test.ts --testTimeout 1200000
scripts.test:keygen:ts:concurrent: pnpm run typecheck && RUN_RSA_KEYGEN_TESTS=1 RSA_KEYGEN_RUNS=10 RSA_KEYGEN_CONCURRENT=1 RSA_KEYGEN_TIMEOUT_MS=3600000 vitest run test/keygen.test.ts --testTimeout 3600000
scripts.test:keygen: pnpm run build && pnpm run test:keygen:rust && pnpm run test:keygen:ts
scripts.test:keygen:concurrent: pnpm run build && pnpm run test:keygen:rust:concurrent && pnpm run test:keygen:ts:concurrent
scripts.test: pnpm run build && pnpm run test:rust && pnpm run test:ts
scripts.pack: pnpm run build && wasm-pack pack --pkg-dir pkg
scripts.publish: pnpm run build && npm publish ./pkg --access public
scripts.publish:dry-run: pnpm run build && npm publish ./pkg --access public --dry-run
